dedupe_keys.name: dataset 15 aerpaw rf sensor measurements with uav july 2024

description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. This July 2024 campaign combines time-difference-of-arrival UAV position estimates, ground-truth positions and line-of-sight or non-line-of-sight tower indicators. Four Keysight RF sensors occupy LW2 through LW5. The described experiments use 3.32 GHz signals, bandwidths of 1.25, 2.5 and 5 MHz, and UAV heights of 40, 70 and 100 metres. Ray-tracing simulations help interpret line-of-sight conditions for localisation-algorithm evaluation. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: RF localisation and ray-tracing model evaluation. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
